description: Close a received return without a refund, e.g. after store credit or a failed inspection: its status moves from received to completed, a final state. No money moves and stock does not change - receive_return already put the restocked units back. Refused unless the return is received, so a second call is refused. To record money sent back, refund_return instead - it also completes a received return. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.
name: complete_return
title: Complete return
